assets.title: Eight-Slot Empty Dish Drying Rack
assets.description: Original S01 empty countertop dish rack: nine continuous rounded ivory dividers make eight vertical slots with measured 35 mm clear spacing. Three 14 mm wide bottom bearing strips have a 71 mm top support plane; the open spaces between them expose a separate shallow seafoam catch tray below. Four grounded broad foot-posts, low fixed frame and two maple-colored end loops complete one editable static rack. Metres, bottom-centre origin, slot repeat along X. No dishes, moving tray, water flow, load rating, stability certification, capacity, dynamic insertion or existing-tableware compatibility claim.
